---
title: "Two StoryMaps from the Maya Forest"
date: 2024-03-01
description: "Bilingual StoryMaps share what we learned in the Calakmul–Sian Ka'an corridor with the communities who taught us."
categories: [outreach]
---

As part of our Fulbright–National Geographic project we published two StoryMaps:

- [*There is a train across the jungle*](https://arcg.is/1zj81z1): voices and visions on the Maya Train, Sembrando Vida and the future of the Maya Forest.
- [*El susurro de los árboles*](https://arcg.is/10vTeP2): forest degradation and regeneration in the Calakmul–Sian Ka'an corridor.
